summary: Current source passes the focused unresolved-safety oracle rejection, producer masking/raw-reason preservation, cooperative logical discovery, and no-custom-runtime-cutoff checks. Split support is present in source but lacks a split contract test, explicit repeated-step exactly-once assertion, and paired oracle raw evidence. No scientific result claim is accepted.

oracle_rejects_resigned_unresolved_safet.details: Raw unresolved reasons are derived from persisted continuation receipts and valid trace cost recomputation raises GAIN_ORACLE_VALID_TRACE_HAS_UNRESOLVED_SAFETY before a valid gain can be returned. The focused test re-signs trace, pair, and label hashes after injecting a live unresolved receipt and expects rejection.

producer_masks_unresolved_safety_preserv.details: Runner applies and verifies live safety, records raw receipt/disposition/unknown_reason, forces NOOP on unresolved state, and paired collection masks branch/pair/label validity while retaining the raw receipt and reason.

cooperative_logical_completion_delayed_o.details: Logical completion requires all manifest children; discovery is scheduled once with parent inspection_id and report_delay, and due reports are received once. The cooperative test covers partial completion, delayed visibility, and parent causal IDs, but does not count events after repeated NOOP steps.

split_support_and_evidence.details: Source creates split/cooperate child manifests and routes both through generic logical completion/discovery. No split test exists in the focused contract file; no exact-once repeated-step assertion or paired oracle closure is present. This is an evidence limitation even though source semantics appear correct.

no_custom_runtime_cutoff.details: Runner loops on environment terminated/truncated state and records wall/CPU/RSS receipts. No custom timeout/cutoff/resource termination branch is present. Protocol horizon limits are simulation semantics. Config explicitly states no automatic time or memory termination.

evidence_limits.details: No split operation/test in package/tests/test_v33_scenario_contract.py; source-level support is provisional only.
Current cooperative test finds one report event but does not assert zero additional report_generated/report_received events after repeated NOOP steps.
No local raw paired keep/replan traces, label, and independent oracle receipt tied to a revealed dependent rescue were supplied.
The failed wrapper receipt is preserved for diagnostics and excluded from experiment data.
